ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area covering approximately 98% of the visible fluke, creating high macro-level contrast against the high-intensity (white) water background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) pigmentation across the majority of the fluke surface. High-intensity (white) pixel clusters are localized at the extreme distal lateral margins (left and right tips). Subtle high-frequency white speckling is visible in the lower central region near the peduncle attachment.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped central depression with an acute internal pixel angle; characterized by high-depth penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) across the entire span of both lobes, appearing more densely jagged on the inner sections of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sloping trajectory; the outer margins exhibit a smooth convex curve that terminates in narrow, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated along the trailing and lateral edges of both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct, vertically-oriented high-intensity linear mark (scratch) located on the mid-left lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the notch to the left tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal lateral margins of both lobes and a prominent vertical linear scar on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The lateral margins are characterized by a dense, continuous fringe of high-intensity calcified structures following the curvature of the tips.
